story.title: Travel planning should feel personal again.
story.paragraphOne: Most travel products force people into endless lists, filters, and tabs before they even know what fits their trip. Okeyo starts from intent instead: mood, budget, location, timing, and the type of stay or activity that feels right.
story.paragraphTwo: We use AI to shorten the path from uncertainty to confidence, but we keep the product grounded in real inventory, clear information, and a calmer booking experience.

presence.title: Designed around real destinations, not generic travel noise.
presence.description: The platform is structured to help travelers move from inspiration to decision without losing context. That means clearer route pages, stronger detail pages, and less clutter around the booking moment.
presence.note: We focus on helping travelers understand what a place feels like, who it suits, and why it matches the trip they are trying to build.

curation.title: Curation over volume
curation.description: We would rather present a smaller, clearer set of relevant options than flood travelers with undifferentiated inventory.

guidance.title: Guidance over guesswork
guidance.description: AI is used to help travelers refine the right direction quickly, not to fabricate answers or hide the details that matter.

trust.title: Trust over friction
trust.description: Clear metadata, transparent pricing signals, and stronger page structure make the product easier to evaluate for both people and search engines.

general-response-times.question: How quickly does the support team reply?
general-response-times.answer:
We usually reply within **24 hours** on business days.

- Urgent booking and payment issues are prioritized first.
- Include screenshots, dates, and booking references to speed things up.

general-contact-options.question: What is the fastest way to contact Okeyo Travel?
general-contact-options.answer:
For routine questions, email support is the best starting point.

- Email us at `support@okeyotravel.com`.
- Use WhatsApp or phone for urgent, time-sensitive travel issues.

booking-modify.question: Can I change a booking after it has been confirmed?
booking-modify.answer:
Booking changes depend on the host's availability and cancellation rules.

1. Open your booking details page.
2. Review the experience policy.
3. Contact support if the change cannot be handled directly.

booking-cancel.question: How do cancellations and refunds work?
booking-cancel.answer:
Refunds follow the cancellation policy attached to the booking.

- Flexible experiences usually refund more when cancelled early.
- Some fees may be non-refundable after the free-cancellation window closes.

payments-charge.question: I was charged but did not receive a confirmation. What should I do?
payments-charge.answer:
Start by checking your bookings page and inbox for a pending confirmation.

If nothing appears within a few minutes, send us:
- the payment date
- the amount charged
- the last 4 digits of the card

payments-refund-time.question: How long do refunds take to appear?
payments-refund-time.answer:
Most refunds appear within **5 to 10 business days**, depending on your bank.

Some banks display the reversal faster, while others keep the transaction pending longer.

account-login.question: I cannot log in to my account. What can I do?
account-login.answer:
Try the basics first:

- confirm you are using the same email you signed up with
- retry after clearing cached auth state
- use the correct sign-in provider if you registered with Google or Apple

account-profile.question: Can I update my profile details and language preferences?
account-profile.answer: Yes. Visit **Settings** to update your preferred language, then open **Profile** for personal details like your display name and bio.

host-visibility.question: Why is my experience not visible to travelers?
host-visibility.answer:
Experiences can be hidden when they are still in review, saved as draft, or manually unpublished.

Check the host visibility page to confirm the listing status before contacting support.

host-booking-issues.question: What should hosts include when reporting an issue?
host-booking-issues.answer:
Include the experience name, the affected booking or departure date, and any screenshots.

The more specific the report, the faster we can reproduce and resolve it.
